reasoning_summary: This opportunity fails three independent hard gates: buildability_with_ai (3 vs floor 6), operational_autonomy (5 vs floor 7), and total score (5.8 vs 6.5 minimum). The product requires a document rendering pipeline, real-time per-page analytics, dynamic watermarking, and multi-format support — none of which are achievable with Claude + prompts + simple web tooling. Even a stripped-down MVP would demand significant ongoing human fulfillment. The cost-to-gain ratio of 6.55 is over 10× the kill threshold of 0.6, and the 90-day expected gain is negative (-$196). While the market is real and buyers clearly pay (DocSend $45-150/user/mo), this is fundamentally the wrong product for this factory's capabilities. Killing rather than deferring because no realistic timeline resolves the buildability gap without external engineering resources.
